name: Heart of the Fluft
text: Play: Combine your Poro followers into a Fluft of Poros, and grant it their stats and positive keywords.

name: Plunder Poro
text: Keywords: Plunder. Plunder: Grant me 2 random keywords.

name: Patched Porobot
text: While in hand, I have a random keyword that changes each round. When I'm summoned, grant me this keyword.

name: Mechanized Mimic
text: Keywords: Augment. Attack: Grant me all keywords on allies.

name: Give It All
text: Grow all allies' Power and Health to the highest Power or Health among allies. Grant all allies allied keywords.

name: Quicksand
text: Give an enemy -4|-0 or 2 enemies -1|-0 this round. Disable their positive keywords this round.

name: Fabled Poro
text: When I'm summoned, grant Poro allies a random keyword.

name: Mask Mother
text: Keywords: Fearsome. Play: Kill an ally to grant me its stats and keywords.

name: The Arsenal
text: When I'm summoned, grant me a random keyword for each allied landmark you've destroyed this game. When you destroy an allied landmark, grant me a random keyword.

name: Tornado Warrior
text: When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+0 and a random keyword. I keep these stat buffs and keywords when I'm Recalled.

name: Hothead
text: Attack: Grant the top champion in your deck +1|+1 and a random keyword.

name: Mikhael's Blessing
text: Grant an ally +1|+2 and remove all negative keywords from it.

name: Solitude
text: When I'm summoned, summon a random Husk. When you summon a 1 cost ally, grant it a random keyword.

name: Void Abomination
text: Keywords: Evolve. When I'm summoned, grant me all positive keywords allies have had this game. When an ally has a new positive keyword, grant it to me.

name: Hive Herald
text: Keywords: Evolve. Play: Grant a unit and me each other's positive keywords.

name: Voidling
text: Keywords: Evolve. While in hand, I have a random keyword that changes each round. When I'm summoned, grant me this keyword.

name: Sharesies
text: Give an ally with an attachment the stats and keywords of its attachment this round and move the attachment to another ally.

name: Skrappy's Partsapalooza
text: Keywords: Landmark. When I'm discarded, summon me. When you summon a Mecha Yordle, grant it a random keyword.

name: Void Gate
text: Keywords: Landmark. When you summon an ally or an ally dies, grant each of its positive keywords to 3 allies in your deck.

name: Beguiling Cobra
text: Each round, the first time you play another follower, summon an exact copy of it. If your board is full, grant its stats and keywords to me instead.

name: Horned Swarmcaller
text: Keywords: Fury. Play: Grant two enemies -1|-0 and disable their positive keywords.

name: Lux: Illuminated
text: Keywords: Spirit, Support. Support: Grant my supported ally Spirit and give me Barrier this round. Level up: Allies have attacked with or have gained while attacking 20+ total positive keywords.

name: Luminosprite
text: Keywords: Support. Support: Give my supported ally all of my positive keywords and their stacks this round.

name: Zed (level 2)
text: Keywords: Quick Attack. Attack: Summon an attacking Living Shadow with my stats and positive keywords.

name: Zoe (level 2)
text: Keywords: Elusive, Missing Translation. When I level up, grant your Nexus "When you summon an ally, grant its keywords to all allies." Nexus Strike: Create a Behold the Infinite that costs 0 in hand.

name: Sivir (level 2)
text: Keywords: Quick Attack, SpellShield. While I'm attacking, attacking allies have my keywords.

name: Pantheon (level 2)
text: Keywords: Overwhelm, Barrier. Once a Pantheon has leveled up, grant me a random keyword for each round you've targeted allies this game.

name: Kai'Sa (level 2)
text: Keywords: Evolve. When I'm summoned or Round Start: If you have the attack token, create a Second Skin in hand. Attack: Deal 1 for each positive keyword I have to enemies or the enemy Nexus (lowest health first).

name: Hex Core Upgrade
text: Keywords: Slow, Fleeting. Grant Viktor a random keyword.

name: Adaptatron 3000
text: When you summon a Tech, we share keywords.

name: Quicksand (created)
text: Keywords: Burst. Give 2 enemies -1|-0 and disable their positive keywords this round.

name: Quicksand (created)
text: Keywords: Burst. Give an enemy -4|-0 and disable its positive keywords this round.

name: Exalted Poro
text: I have 3 random keywords.

name: Rainbowfish (created)
text: Keywords: Elusive, Attach. Attach me to an ally to give it my stats and keywords while I'm Attached. When that ally leaves play, Recall me.

name: Papercraft Dragon (created)
text: Keywords: Attach, Double Attack. Attach me to an ally to give it my stats and keywords while I'm Attached. When that ally leaves play, Recall me.

name: Quick Quill (created)
text: Keywords: Attach, Quick Attack. Attach me to an ally to give it my stats and keywords while I'm Attached. When that ally leaves play, Recall me.

name: Acceleration Gate
text: Keywords: Slow. Give allies +2|+0 and Quick Attack this round. If they already have it or Double Attack, give them a random keyword instead.

name: Breakneck Husk
text: Keywords: Immobile, Quick Attack. When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.

name: Haunted Husk
text: Keywords: Immobile, Fearsome. When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.

name: Warded Husk
text: Keywords: Immobile, SpellShield. When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.

name: Fading Husk
text: Keywords: Immobile, Elusive. When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.

name: Thrashing Husk
text: Keywords: Immobile, Overwhelm. When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.

name: Scattered Husk
text: Keywords: Immobile, Impact. When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.

name: Desperate Husk
text: Keywords: Immobile, Challenger. When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.

name: Enraged Husk
text: Keywords: Immobile, Fury. When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.

name: Hardy Husk
text: Keywords: Immobile, Tough. When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.

name: Stubborn Husk
text: Keywords: Immobile, Regeneration. When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.

name: Nagakabouros' Tentacle
text: Keywords: Ephemeral. When I'm summoned, grow my stats to that of your strongest Tentacle and grant me its keywords.

name: Icathian Rain
text: Keywords: Skill. Deal 1 for each positive keyword Kai'Sa has to enemies or the enemy Nexus (lowest health first).

name: Second Skin
text: Keywords: Slow, Fleeting. Grant allied Kai'Sas everywhere another ally's positive keywords.

name: Horazi
text: Keywords: SpellShield, Support. Support: Grow my supported ally's stats to mine. Give it my positive keywords this round.

name: Explorer's Blunder
text: Keywords: Focus. Disable an enemy's positive keywords this round and again at next Round Start.
